Zane is a 28-year-old lizard woman who lives on the island of Lizard Point in the north of the land of Eternia and the world of Barsoom. She loves hunting and surviving with the lizard people, but hates visitors to the island. She is a ruthless woman who hates humans. The Lizard People are considered stupid and uneducated due to the lack of society on the island. Zane uses both of her magical powers to hunt and survive.
